Transactions run from 8/26/2021 through 9/27/2021 across 36 pages. Charges subtotal 392,473.77 against 4,109.45 in credits, yielding Total Expenses of 388,364.32. The single largest lines are APPLE.COM/US charges of 10,590.00 in budget unit 419160225407500 and a 9,750.00 payment to SCENARIO LEA in 101700283034100.

**Report identity**

Every page repeats the banner "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, September 2021" and the column set Transaction Description / JE Number / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits. Pages are numbered 1 through 36. All lines carry the journal-entry description "SEP PCARD EXP."
